content_fields.title: Prioritize static network configuration
content_fields.description: Prefer static, declared network configuration over dynamically discovered addressing.
content_fields.guidance: Addresses, subnets and routes for the service tier should be declared and version-controlled, so connectivity does not depend on runtime discovery that an attacker could influence.
content_fields.found: Container addressing is left entirely to Docker's default bridge with no declared subnet, and the application resolves the database by the service name `db`.
content_fields.missing: A declared network topology at the platform level, including subnets and address assignment.
content_fields.conclusion: Network addressing policy is defined by the platform that hosts the containers rather than by this repository.
content_fields.action: The platform team should declare the network topology and addressing for the service tier.
